title: Automation & Token Efficiency
description: Verify auto-registration pipeline end-to-end, optimize session-start for conditional loading, stress-test multi-Claude coordination, expand hookify automation coverage.

steps.instruction: Create a test engine file and verify hookify master-index-drift fires
Run /pick-task completion checklist on a test unit and verify all 11 steps execute
Run /audit-task on a completed milestone and verify findings are saved
Document the 3-layer auto-registration flow with sequence diagram
Measure current session-start token cost (hook output + CLAUDE.md loading)
Implement conditional context loading based on working directory
Reduce session-start hook output to essential information only
Measure improved token cost and document savings
Write a script that simulates 3 concurrent claim attempts on the same unit
Verify exactly 1 wins and 2 get EEXIST
Test heartbeat renewal and stale reap timing
Create autofire rule for /pick-task on session start with open roadmap items
Create autofire rule for /audit-task when working in completed milestone directories
Review all 40 existing hookify rules for staleness or redundancy
Consolidate or remove rules that no longer add value
Create a script that reads live system counts and compares to CLAUDE.md values
Create a cadence function or hookify rule that warns when counts drift
Wire the drift check into the /audit-task flow
